title: Fixed fractions lift from the fraction field of an invariant base ring
statement: Let $G$ be a finite group acting by ring automorphisms on a commutative integral domain $S$, meaning a nonzero commutative ring without zero divisors. Let $R$ be another commutative integral domain and let $f:R\to S$ be an injective unital ring homomorphism whose image is precisely $S^G=\{s\in S:gs=s\text{ for all }g\in G\}$. Let $K$ and $L$ be fraction fields of $R$ and $S$, respectively, with their canonical injective structure maps $\iota_R:R\to K$ and $\iota_S:S\to L$; thus each element is a quotient of two ring elements with nonzero denominator. Suppose $v:K\to L$ is a unital ring homomorphism satisfying $v\circ\iota_R=\iota_S\circ f$. Give $L$ the extended action $g(\iota_S(s)/\iota_S(t))=\iota_S(gs)/\iota_S(gt)$ for $t\ne0$. Then every $x\in L$ fixed by all $g\in G$ has the form $v(y)$ for some $y\in K$. The homomorphism $v$ is a field extension in the sense of [def-pc-field-extension].
